title: 73. Archiving feature
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: Archiving feature.
short_answer: You can archive your survey with all its submitted answers to reload it or to launch the same survey again at a later point in time. To archive your survey, select the 'Archive Survey' icon in the action menu of the 'Overview' page.
procedure: Archived surveys cannot be edited or collect any data. But you can export results or request a PDF-file of your survey. The archived survey will be available from the 'Dashboard' page, from where it can also be restored. A restored survey can be edited again.
